predator_encounter.name: Predator Encounter
predator_encounter.description: Danger approaches! A large predator is sizing you up from the shadows.

run.description: Flee at top speed, using whatever movement you are best at.

hide.description: Attempt to blend into the surrounding vegetation, terrain, or shadows.

fight.description: Confront the danger aggressively to stand your ground.

food_shortage.name: Food Shortage
food_shortage.description: Resources are dwindling in this territory. Finding nutrients is paramount.

hunt.description: Exert extensive energy to actively forage, hunt, or track down nourishment.

scavenge.description: Look for leftover edible organic material nearby.

rest.description: Lower your activity level to survive on your current reserves.

sudden_storm.name: Sudden Storm
sudden_storm.description: Violent winds rise and torrential weather changes your visibility.

shelter.description: Seek protection under heavy terrain elements, local canopy, or any solid cover.

keep_moving.description: Brave the elements and travel onward regardless.

find_water.description: Take advantage of the downpour to collect and store moisture.

river_crossing.name: River Crossing
river_crossing.description: A body of moving water blocks your path forward.

swim.description: Cross directly, testing your physical endurance in the current.

find_bridge.description: Look for alternative routes, like fallen trees, stepping stones, or shallow areas.

follow_river.description: Travel alongside the bank to scout for a safer crossing.

nightfall.name: Nightfall
nightfall.description: Ambient light fades away, and the nocturnal cycle begins.

explore.description: Rely on your strongest senses to keep moving in the darkness.

sleep.description: Find a safe, secluded spot to restore your stamina until dawn.

stay_alert.description: Stay awake and actively monitor for unseen dangers.

strange_glow.name: Mysterious Environment
strange_glow.description: You enter an area alive with unusual natural phenomena - strange lights, colors, or sounds unlike anywhere you have been.

communicate.description: Interact cautiously with the unfamiliar elements around you, in whatever way your species communicates.

harvest.description: Forage carefully for unusual nutrients or materials the area might offer.

hide_glow.description: Conceal yourself so you are not exposed against the strange backdrop.

habitat_loss.name: Habitat Loss
habitat_loss.description: Strange creatures are clearing away parts of your home territory, and the landscape is changing fast.

investigate.description: Move closer to observe what is happening and how it might affect you.

relocate.description: Abandon the area and search for untouched territory.

adapt.description: Stay put and adjust your routines around the new conditions.

severe_drought.name: Severe Drought
severe_drought.description: The rains have not come for weeks. Water holes are shrinking and the land is cracked and dry.

seek_water.description: Travel far in search of a reliable water source.

dig.description: Try to reach moisture hidden beneath the dry surface.

conserve.description: Rest in the shade and conserve every drop of energy and moisture.

wildfire_threat.name: Wildfire Threat
wildfire_threat.description: Smoke drifts on the wind and an orange glow builds on the horizon - fire is spreading toward your territory.

flee.description: Run ahead of the flames toward safer ground.

shelter_underground.description: Burrow deep or find solid shelter that fire cannot easily reach.

wait_and_watch.description: Monitor the wind and flames closely, ready to move at the last moment.

flash_flood.name: Flash Flood
flash_flood.description: A wall of rushing water surges through your path, turning familiar ground into a churning torrent.

climb.description: Scramble to higher ground before the water reaches you.

ride_it_out.description: Find a sturdy anchor and hold on until the surge passes.

swim_out.description: Use the current itself to carry you to calmer water.

winter_blizzard.name: Winter Blizzard
winter_blizzard.description: Snow lashes down in blinding sheets and the temperature plummets. The world has turned white and hostile.

dig_in.description: Create a snow shelter or find a hollow to wait out the storm.

push_on.description: Keep moving through the whiteout toward your goal.

huddle.description: Curl up tight and let your body's warmth carry you through.

extreme_heat.name: Extreme Heat
extreme_heat.description: The sun beats down mercilessly and the air shimmers. Heat presses on you from every direction.

find_shade.description: Seek out the coolest shadow you can find and wait for dusk.

travel_night.description: Rest now and do your moving during the cool of night.

keep_going.description: Press on through the heat despite the risk.

dense_fog.name: Dense Fog
dense_fog.description: A thick fog rolls in, swallowing landmarks and muffling every sound.

slow_down.description: Move carefully, navigating by touch and close observation.

wait.description: Stay still until the fog lifts and the view clears.

use_senses.description: Trust your strongest sense - smell, sound, or sight - to guide you through.

lost_family.name: Lost from the Group
lost_family.description: You look around and realize you have wandered apart from your family or group, and nothing looks familiar.

call_out.description: Signal loudly in whatever way your kind communicates.

retrace.description: Carefully follow your own trail back toward where you split up.

wait.description: Stay where you are - they may come looking for you.

territorial_rival.name: Territorial Rival
territorial_rival.description: Another animal of your kind has appeared on the edge of your territory, testing your resolve.

display.description: Put on your most impressive display to warn the rival away.

confront.description: Meet the challenger directly and settle the dispute.

withdraw.description: Give ground quietly and avoid a costly fight.

food_thief.name: Food Thief
food_thief.description: You catch another animal raiding your carefully stored food supply.

defend.description: Drive the thief away from your cache.

share.description: Tolerate the loss and let the thief take a portion.

rehide.description: Quietly plan to move your remaining stores somewhere safer.

injured_limb.name: Injured Limb
injured_limb.description: A misstep on rough ground leaves you with a painful injury that slows your every move.

rest.description: Stop and give the injury time to heal before moving on.

push_through.description: Keep moving despite the pain and favor your good side.

find_help.description: Seek out a safer spot or allies who can ease your situation.

human_trap.name: Human Trap
human_trap.description: A strange human device - a snare or cage - lies hidden along a trail you often use.

avoid.description: Mark the spot and steer your whole group away from the danger.

disable.description: Carefully trigger or damage the device so it can hurt no one.

warn_others.description: Risk lingering to watch and warn others away from the area.

road_crossing.name: Road Crossing
road_crossing.description: A broad ribbon of human pavement stretches before you, with speeding metal beasts rushing past.

dash.description: Time a gap in the traffic and sprint across.

find_tunnel.description: Search for a culvert, bridge, or gap that lets you cross underneath.

travel_dusk.description: Wait until traffic quiets down at dusk to cross.

hikers_encounter.name: Hiker Encounter
hikers_encounter.description: A group of humans on foot wanders through your territory, making noise and leaving scent everywhere.

observe.description: Watch from cover to understand what they want.

retreat.description: Slip away silently and keep your distance.

approach.description: Boldly move closer - their packs may hold dropped crumbs.

polluted_water.name: Polluted Water
polluted_water.description: A strange chemical sheen and bitter smell coat the water source you depend on.

avoid_drinking.description: Refuse the tainted water and search for a clean source.

sip_carefully.description: Drink only from the clearest edge and hope for the best.

report.description: Leave scent and sound warnings so others know to stay away.

winter_scarcity.name: Winter Scarcity
winter_scarcity.description: Deep winter has locked away food beneath snow and frost, and hunger gnaws at you.

dig.description: Dig through the snow to reach hidden food below.

relocate.description: Travel to lower ground where winter is milder.

fast.description: Ride out the scarcity by slowing your body down and waiting.

seasonal_migration.name: Seasonal Migration
seasonal_migration.description: The season is turning, and the ancient pull to move to new grounds stirs in you.

migrate.description: Join the great movement and travel with others heading the same way.

stay.description: Remain in familiar territory and tough out the changing season.

go_solo.description: Set out alone on your own route and your own schedule.

shelter_search.name: Shelter Search
shelter_search.description: Night is coming and your old shelter is gone. You need a new refuge before dark.

search_high.description: Scout the ridges and trees for a protected nook.

search_low.description: Investigate burrows, hollows, and gaps beneath roots.

improvise.description: Build a quick shelter from branches, grass, or stones.

unknown_creature.name: Unknown Creature
unknown_creature.description: An animal you have never seen before emerges nearby - neither predator nor prey, simply strange.

approach.description: Edge closer to satisfy your curiosity about the newcomer.

observe.description: Keep a safe distance and study its behavior.

avoid.description: Give it a wide berth and carry on your way.

mysterious_sound.name: Mysterious Sound
mysterious_sound.description: A rhythmic, unknown sound echoes from deeper in the wilderness - not quite danger, not quite friend.

investigate.description: Follow the sound carefully to find its source.

answer.description: Call back with a sound of your own and see what responds.

ignore.description: Steer clear of the noise and whatever makes it.

strange_tracks.name: Strange Tracks
strange_tracks.description: A line of unusual tracks cuts across your path - bigger than anything you know.

follow.description: Track them carefully to learn what left them.

memorize.description: Study the pattern closely and commit it to memory.

back_away.description: Head in the opposite direction from the tracks.

hidden_cache.name: Hidden Cache
hidden_cache.description: Your nose leads you to another animal's secret store of food, rich and unguarded.

take_some.description: Eat your fill but leave most of the cache intact.

take_all.description: Empty the cache completely - a windfall now, a risk later.

leave_it.description: Leave it alone - stealing from neighbors invites trouble.

pest_infestation.name: Pest Infestation
pest_infestation.description: Tiny biting pests have infested your resting place, and the itching is maddening.

groom.description: Spend an hour carefully removing the pests one by one.

relocate.description: Abandon the infested spot and find cleaner ground.

endure.description: Tolerate the irritation and stay where you are.

risky_feast.name: Risky Feast
risky_feast.description: A treasure of food lies in the open - but something about the scene feels like a trap.

feast_fast.description: Eat as much as you can, as quickly as you can, and bolt.

circle.description: Circle the prize patiently, watching for whatever guards it.

resist.description: Walk away - no meal is worth an unknown danger.

injured_stranger.name: Injured Stranger
injured_stranger.description: You find another animal - not of your kind - hurt and helpless on the trail.

help.description: Stay close, offer comfort or aid in whatever way you can.

ignore.description: Pass by - nature takes its course.

alert_others.description: Call out to attract others who might help.

courtship_season.name: Courtship Season
courtship_season.description: The season of courtship arrives, and rivals are showing off all around you.

perform.description: Put on your finest display and compete for attention.

observe.description: Watch the competition first and learn what works.

withdraw.description: Skip the contest this season and build strength instead.

home_building.name: Home Building
home_building.description: It is time to build or repair a home for the season ahead.

gather_best.description: Search far and wide for the finest materials.

use_local.description: Work with whatever is close at hand.

take_over.description: Find an abandoned structure and claim it as your own.

protect_young.name: Protect the Young
protect_young.description: Something dangerous is near, and young ones depend on you for protection.

defend.description: Place yourself between the danger and the young, and hold.

evacuate.description: Move the young to a hidden place before danger arrives.

distract.description: Draw the threat away with a bold diversion.

teach_survival.name: Teach Survival
teach_survival.description: The young ones must learn to find food and avoid danger - and you are their teacher.

demonstrate.description: Show them by doing, letting them copy your every move.

let_them_try.description: Step back and let them practice while you keep watch.

play.description: Turn the lesson into a game - play is how skills grow.

cave_shelter.name: Cave Shelter
cave_shelter.description: A dark opening in the rock promises shelter - and the complete unknown.

enter.description: Venture into the darkness to claim the shelter.

listen.description: Wait at the mouth and listen for signs of occupancy.

pass_by.description: The deep dark is not for you - find shelter elsewhere.

cliff_path.name: Cliff Path
cliff_path.description: The only way forward is a narrow ledge along a sheer cliff face.

edge_carefully.description: Place every step with total focus and cross slowly.

find_detour.description: Search for a longer but safer way around.

turn_back.description: Decide the risk is too great and retrace your steps.

tangled_thicket.name: Tangled Thicket
tangled_thicket.description: A dense tangle of thorny branches bars your way, clutching at every step.

push_through.description: Force a path through the thorns.

tunnel.description: Search the thicket's base for gaps small enough to slip through.

go_around.description: Circle the whole thicket, however long it takes.

frozen_water.name: Frozen Water
frozen_water.description: The lake you know well has frozen over - solid-looking, but the ice may betray you.

cross_light.description: Distribute your weight and cross the ice slowly.

test_edges.description: Test the ice at the shore before committing to a crossing.

walk_around.description: Follow the shoreline instead of trusting the ice.

waterfall_discovery.name: Waterfall Discovery
waterfall_discovery.description: The roar of falling water grows ahead - a huge waterfall you have never seen before.

explore.description: Scout around the falls for new paths and possibilities.

drink.description: Enjoy the freshest water you have ever tasted.

rest.description: Rest in the cool mist and take in the wonder.

strange_scent.name: Strange Scent
strange_scent.description: A scent you have never encountered drifts on the breeze - sweet, sharp, and utterly foreign.

follow.description: Follow the scent trail to its source.

memorize.description: Fix the scent in memory and continue on your way.

mask.description: Roll in something strong to mask your own scent.

abandoned_den.name: Abandoned Den
abandoned_den.description: You stumble on a cozy, well-built den - recently abandoned, by the smell of it.

move_in.description: Claim the den as your own before anyone else does.

inspect.description: Examine it carefully for clues about why it was abandoned.

avoid.description: Whatever drove the last owner out may still be around - pass by.

distant_lights.name: Distant Lights
distant_lights.description: Strange glowing lights flicker on the horizon at night - far away, but drawing nearer over the seasons.

watch.description: Observe the lights from a safe distance night after night.

investigate.description: Creep closer one night to see what makes the glow.

avoid.description: Keep your nighttime routines far from the glow.

loud_machinery.name: Loud Machinery
loud_machinery.description: Monstrous growling machines have appeared nearby, shaking the ground and splitting the air.

flee.description: Run from the noise and the vibrations now.

wait_out.description: Hide in the deepest cover and wait for the workday to end.

relocate.description: Accept that this territory is lost and seek new ground.

litter_entanglement.name: Litter Entanglement
litter_entanglement.description: Discarded human debris litters your path, and one careless step leaves you tangled.

struggle.description: Fight against the tangle with all your strength.

stay_calm.description: Slow down, think, and work yourself free bit by bit.

attract_help.description: Make noise and movement that might draw a helping creature.

rare_sky_event.name: Rare Sky Event
rare_sky_event.description: The night sky erupts in streaks of light as a meteor shower blazes overhead.

watch.description: Sit still and take in the whole spectacle.

hide.description: The strange lights feel ominous - tuck into cover.

celebrate.description: Add your own voice to the sky's performance.

new_water_source.name: New Water Source
new_water_source.description: Melting snow upstream has carved a fresh stream across your territory - new water, new routes, new risks.

explore.description: Follow the new stream to see where it leads.

drink.description: Test the fresh water carefully, then drink deeply.

mark_territory.description: Claim the new water before rivals find it.

overcrowding.name: Overcrowding
overcrowding.description: Too many animals now share your range - every food source picked clean, every shelter taken.

disperse.description: Set out alone for less crowded territory.

compete.description: Fight for your share in the crowded core.

shift_hours.description: Adjust your schedule to forage when others rest.

sickness_outbreak.name: Sickness Outbreak
sickness_outbreak.description: A sickness is spreading through the animals nearby - some have grown weak, others strange.

isolate.description: Keep to yourself until the sickness passes.

help_weak.description: Stay near the ailing and help where you can - at your own risk.

smoke_horizon.name: Smoke on the Horizon
smoke_horizon.description: A gray column rises far away, and the wind carries an acrid smell toward your home.

monitor.description: Watch the smoke closely and note which way the wind turns it.

pre_evacuate.description: Start moving valuables - food, young - toward safer ground early.

ignore.description: It is far away and someone else's problem - for now.

ground_tremor.name: Ground Tremor
ground_tremor.description: The earth shudders and rolls beneath you, toppling stones and sending every creature into a panic.

find_open_ground.description: Get clear of trees and rocks that could fall.

burrow_deep.description: Dive into the most stable shelter you know.

stay_put.description: Freeze and let the shaking pass beneath your feet.

rockslide_blockage.name: Rockslide Blockage
rockslide_blockage.description: A rockslide has buried the trail you always use, sealing the way between you and your range.

climb_over.description: Pick your way across the unstable rubble.

find_route.description: Scout for a new path around the slide.

dig_through.description: Try to clear a small passage through the blockage.

unexpected_alliance.name: Unexpected Alliance
unexpected_alliance.description: A creature of a different kind offers help - warning calls, shared watch duty, or leftovers.

accept.description: Welcome the partnership and watch each other's backs.

observe.description: Keep the offer at a distance and see if it proves true.

decline.description: Trust only your own kind and go it alone.

human_food_gift.name: Human Food Gift
human_food_gift.description: Humans have left food out deliberately - a regular feast in the same spot each day.

take_freely.description: Enjoy the easy meals while they last.

stay_cautious.description: Take a little, watch a lot - gifts can become traps.

avoid.description: Wild food only - dependence is dangerous.

garden_raid.name: Garden Raid
garden_raid.description: A human garden overflows with tender crops, guarded only by a flimsy fence.

raid_boldly.description: Sneak in and feast on the best of the harvest.

raid_edges.description: Nibble only around the margins and leave little trace.

stay_wild.description: Keep to wild foraging - gardens bring humans and danger.

drying_pond.name: Drying Pond
drying_pond.description: Your pond shrinks daily under the hot sun, its edges cracking, its center crowded with desperate creatures.

defend_water.description: Guard your spot at the shrinking edge.

travel.description: Leave before the last drop and seek a new waterhole.

burrow_wait.description: Dig in and wait out the dry season the way your kind does.

shiny_object.name: Shiny Object
shiny_object.description: Something small and glittering catches the light along your path - fascinating and completely out of place.

inspect.description: Investigate the glittering curiosity from every angle.

collect.description: Carry it with you as a treasure.

ignore.description: Leave the strange thing alone and move on.

echo_canyon.name: Echo Canyon
echo_canyon.description: Deep walls of stone rise around you, and every sound you make comes back strange and multiplied.

play.description: Answer the echoes and fill the canyon with your voice.

listen.description: Stay quiet and let the canyon's sounds teach you its shape.

hurry_through.description: The place feels wrong - cross it quickly and quietly.

moonless_night.name: Moonless Night
moonless_night.description: Clouds swallow the moon and stars, leaving a night so dark you cannot see your own feet.

trust_senses.description: Move by memory, scent, and sound alone.

shelter.description: Den up until the sky clears or dawn arrives.

stay_put.description: Freeze in place until your eyes adjust.

occupied_shelter.name: Occupied Shelter
occupied_shelter.description: You return to your shelter to find another animal already curled up inside it.

evict.description: Reclaim your home and drive the intruder out.

share.description: There is room enough - share the shelter for the night.

relocate.description: Not worth the fight - find new quarters.
